ball_sourced.evidence: exports/turret/launch/ball.json: sources with URLs and the date checked; the unknowns swept with a bench plan

launch_cap_70fps.how: the regulated 12 V rail + the SunnySky X2216 880KV V3 (880 rpm/V) + the Ø34 tyre: 10.5 krpm no-load (18.7 m/s surface), so even 100 % throttle on a fast motor and a high rail stays at the figure above; the ESC set speed (8.9 krpm, 52 fps nominal) sits under that, and the chronograph latches SAFE on any ball over 66 fps

feed_no_jam_all_poses.note: misses are empty steps (the hopper not delivering): bridging, which rigid spheres under-predict; the bench counts them
